user.title: Connect your Svago chair
user.description: Confirm the chair is powered on and the Motion Mastery Bluetooth remote is off.

recall_memory.name: Recall saved memory
recall_memory.description: Recall exactly one Memory 1, 2, or 3 button. This action never saves a memory and is blocked while setting one.
